answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. By the beacon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the inlet of a task receipt, and the mesa is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
